'''Edward Schaumberg Quade''' (June 28, 1908 – June 4, 1988)<ref>''California, Death Index, 1940-1997''</ref> was an American mathematician at the [[Rand Corporation]] who worked on trigonometric series and systems analysis.<ref>{{cite news |title=Edward S. Quade, 79; Was Rand Researcher |url=https://www.nytimes.com/1988/06/08/obituaries/edward-s-quade-79-was-rand-researcher.html |accessdate=17 January 2019 |work=The New York Times |date=8 June 1988}}</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=4308}}</ref>
